changelog:
paper-reading-method-inspiration v0.1.0

- Initial release of "Method Inspiration" workflow for collecting transferable modeling ideas from papers.
- Guides users from a rough problem to a structured library of auditable Candidate Methods, stopping short of committing to a single method design.
- Creates and updates organized artifacts within a structured workspace, preserving user edits and reading existing files.
- Enforces clear workflow boundaries: avoids prematurely synthesizing method designs or assigning novelty.
- Integrates checkpoints for user confirmation at key gates (Method Needs, Candidate Methods) and uses local context and evidence before searching for method papers.
summary: Use when the user has a rough problem and reads papers to collect transferable modeling ideas, architectures, training flows, optimization objectives, agent...
